interpretation_ko: 애정이나 사업의 계약이 갑자기 깨질 조짐
interpretation_en: contracts in love or business may be canceled unexpectedly, owing to adverse influences working against your honor

cite.original: To see a panther and experience fright, denotes that contracts in love or business may be canceled unexpectedly, owing to adverse influences working against your honor.
cite.translation_ko: 흑표범을 보고 겁에 질리는 꿈은, 애정이나 사업의 계약이 갑자기 깨질 조짐이다

interpretation_ko: 기쁨을 누리고 하는 일마다 성공할 조짐
interpretation_en: you will experience joy and be successful in your undertakings

cite.original: But killing, or over-powering it, you will experience joy and be successful in your undertakings.
cite.translation_ko: 흑표범을 죽이거나 제압하는 꿈은, 기쁨을 누리고 하는 일마다 성공할 조짐이다

interpretation_ko: 사업에 실망할 일이 생기고 남들이 약속을 저버릴 조짐
interpretation_en: you will have disappointments in business. Other people will likely recede from their promises to you

cite.original: If one menaces you by its presence, you will have disappointments in business. Other people will likely recede from their promises to you.
cite.translation_ko: 흑표범이 위협하듯 나타나는 꿈은, 사업에 실망할 일이 생기고 남들이 약속을 저버릴 조짐이다

interpretation_ko: 불리한 소식이 들려와 이익이 줄고 불화가 생길 조짐
interpretation_en: you will have unfavorable news, coming in the way of reducing profit or gain, and you may have social discord

cite.original: If you hear the voice of a panther, and experience terror or fright, you will have unfavorable news, coming in the way of reducing profit or gain, and you may have social discord; no fright forebodes less evil.
cite.translation_ko: 흑표범 울음소리를 듣고 공포를 느끼는 꿈은, 불리한 소식이 들려와 이익이 줄고 불화가 생길 조짐이다

cite.original: To dream of seeing pantomimes, denotes that your friends will deceive you.
cite.translation_ko: 무언극을 보는 꿈은, 벗에게 속을 조짐이다

interpretation_ko: 언짢은 일이 생기고 일이 만족스럽지 못할 조짐
interpretation_en: you will have cause of offense. Affairs will not prove satisfactory

cite.original: If you participate in them, you will have cause of offense. Affairs will not prove satisfactory.
cite.translation_ko: 무언극에 참여하는 꿈은, 언짢은 일이 생기고 일이 만족스럽지 못할 조짐이다

interpretation_ko: 손실을 볼 조짐이며 대개 송사와 관련됨
interpretation_en: you will be threatened with losses. They are likely to be in the nature of a lawsuit

cite.original: If you have occasion in your dreams to refer to, or handle, any paper or parchment, you will be threatened with losses. They are likely to be in the nature of a lawsuit.
cite.translation_ko: 종이나 양피지를 다루거나 참조하는 꿈은, 손실을 볼 조짐이며 대개 송사와 관련된다

interpretation_ko: 애인에게 화가 나고 남들 평판을 두려워할 조짐
interpretation_en: she will be angry with her lover and that she fears the opinion of acquaintances

cite.original: For a young woman, it means that she will be angry with her lover and that she fears the opinion of acquaintances.
cite.translation_ko: 처녀가 종이나 양피지 꿈을 꾸면, 애인에게 화가 나고 남들 평판을 두려워할 조짐이다

interpretation_en: beware, if you are married, of disagreements in the precincts of the home

cite.original: Beware, if you are married, of disagreements in the precincts of the home.
cite.translation_ko: 기혼자가 종이나 양피지 꿈을 꾸면, 집안에 다툼이 있을까 조심할 조짐이다
